info.name: Football Intelligence App API
info.description: REST API collection for the Football Intelligence App FastAPI backend. Folders are ordered so running the whole collection top-to-bottom (Collection Runner) satisfies foreign-key dependencies: each 'Create' request captures the new record's id into a collection variable that later folders reuse. Every endpoint responds with the common envelope: { status, message, result, error }. Every request has saved example responses (Success, Validation Error, Conflict, Not Found as applicable) captured live against a running instance backed by the pre-loaded mock dataset in data/*.csv. A collection-level pre-request script generates a random 'run_suffix' variable once per run and several Create bodies embed it in their unique fields (role code, user email, season name, etc.), so the collection can be run repeatedly against the same persistent dataset without ever hitting a 409 conflict from its own past runs or from the seed data.
